name: Say It Out
title: Learning Sentence By Sentence
subtitle: Learn - Say It Out
description: No matter what language you are learning, with just an audio file, “Say it out” will automatically divide it into small sentences. So you can listen intently and imitate sentence by sentence, over and over again. It can also check what you said is correct or not sentence by sentence automatically. Its innovative learning methods, efficiency and ease of use will bring you a new and excellent language learning experience.

name: eQuicker24
title: Let's get more close
subtitle: eQuicker24 v1.0
description: A traditional family mathematical game for training mental arithmetic and quick reaction. There are 52 cards at the beginning, randomly took out 4 cards each time, the first one who achieves the number 24 exactly using only +, -, *, / get 1 point. The game ends when the card is exhausted, and the player who gets more points wins.

detailMedia.title: Game opening
detailMedia.description: Start a round and prepare the deck for a quick arithmetic challenge.

detailMedia.title: Four-card challenge
detailMedia.description: Four cards are shown together so players can search for a route to 24.

detailMedia.title: Work out the answer
detailMedia.description: Combine the numbers with basic arithmetic while trying to react faster than the other players.

detailMedia.title: Round result
detailMedia.description: Record the successful answer and award the point to the first player who finds it.

detailMedia.title: Keep playing
detailMedia.description: Continue through the deck and see who finishes with the highest score.

items.title: Start with four cards
items.text: Each round begins with four randomly selected cards and one clear goal: reach the number 24.

items.title: Look for a route

items.title: Use basic arithmetic
items.text: Add, subtract, multiply, or divide the cards to find an exact solution.

items.title: Win the round

items.title: Play to the end
items.text: Continue until the deck is exhausted and compare the final scores.

name: ShowAce
title: Memories on the table
subtitle: ShowAce v2.0
description: Without doing anything. ShowAce will loop through your photos/videos one by one on full screen with time and place they were taken. You can easily highlight the best part of each photo to make it look better and more attractive. Of course, you can easily hide the photos and videos you do not want to show too. Also you can draw customized photo frames for each album and add them on top of your photos/videos to make it more special and caring.

name: Say It Out - EN / 英语说起来
title: Practice English by Speaking
subtitle: Say It Out - English
description: Say It Out - EN helps you practice with the English you actually want to learn. Choose a built-in story, scan a page, import a PDF or text file, paste in a favorite paragraph, or practice with a real human recording or a lesson shared by your teacher. Listen to one sentence, read it aloud, record yourself, and see how you did with an overall score and word-level feedback. Your best recording is saved, and the app highlights the three words to focus on next.
overview: Listen. Speak. Check your result. Try again. Turn the English you understand into English you can say.
features: Practice with real human recordings or teacher-shared lessons, alongside built-in stories and your own materials.
Listen to one sentence, read it aloud, and record yourself.
See an overall score and feedback for every word.
Save your highest score and best recording.
Focus on the three words the app highlights next.
Adjust how much text stays visible as the challenge increases.
Look up word meanings and pronunciation, and translate sentences.
Replay your recordings and follow your progress over time.
closing: Listen. Speak. Check your result. Try again.
Turn the English you understand into English you can say.
steps: Listen first
Play the original or system-read sentence before starting your recording.
Speak it out
Say the sentence from memory and let the app recognize your spoken English.
Practice again
Use the score and word feedback to decide what to repeat next.
audience: English learners who want a short, clear loop for listening, speaking, and remembering.

items: Your profile, learning records, recordings, and imported materials are stored on your device.
The camera is used for scanning, the microphone is used for recording, and speech recognition is provided by Apple.
Words you look up may be sent to Datamuse (api.datamuse.com). Translation uses Apple Translation.
This app does not require an account and does not use advertising or tracking. You can delete your data in the app.

items.title: Create or choose your profile

items.text: Choose a sentence → Listen to the original audio → Read → Record yourself speaking → Check your score → Practice the target words.

items.title: Speaking score & feedback
items.text: Review word-by-word feedback, replay your recordings and best score, and practice again to improve.

items.title: Lesson results
items.text: Review your scores, play your recordings, and improve sentence by sentence.

items.title: All learned sentences
items.text: Review all learned sentences, replay recordings, and keep improving.

items.title: Listening challenge
items.text: Five levels take you from full support to blind reading. The higher the level, the less text and help you see.
